description: This file implements a dynamic rate limiter for a machine learning API proxy, managing active project counts and token rate limits per model. It includes classes for caching active usage, checking token availability, and integrating rate limiting into API call hooks.

classes.name: DynamicRateLimiterCache
classes.description: A thin wrapper around DualCache to manage active project counts per model in a specific time window.

classes.name: _PROXY_DynamicRateLimitHandler
classes.description: Handles rate limiting logic, caching, and hook integration for API request flow, including pre-call checks and post-call annotation.

methods.name: Optional[int] async_get_cache(self, model: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the current count of active projects for a given model within the current minute.

methods.name: async_set_cache_sadd(self, model: str, value: List)
methods.description: Adds a set of project identifiers to the cache for the current model and minute.

methods.name: update_variables(self, llm_router: Router)
methods.description: Sets the router reference for later usage.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[int],Optional[int],Optional[int],Optional[int],Optional[int]] check_available_usage( self, model: str, priority: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Checks token availability (TPM/RPM) and current usage for a specific model with optional priority adjustment.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Pre-request hook that enforces rate limits before a model call, potentially raising HTTP 429 errors.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response )
methods.description: Post-request hook that annotates responses with current rate limit info and updates usage cache.

ctags.name: async_get_cache
ctags.pattern: /^    async def async_get_cache(self, model: str) -> Optional[int]:$/

ctags.name: async_post_call_success_hook
ctags.signature: ( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response )

ctags.name: async_pre_call_hook
ctags.signature: ( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )

ctags.name: async_set_cache_sadd
ctags.pattern: /^    async def async_set_cache_sadd(self, model: str, value: List):$/

ctags.name: check_available_usage
ctags.signature: ( self, model: str, priority: Optional[str] = None )
